ctx.x: Now your mother. What was her name?

Virginia Burley, B-u-r-l-e-y. She was born in Atlanta, Georgia, and she played piano for the church, danced for the church to raise money. She said that they'd pull a curtain down across the pulpit and she'd dance to raise money for the church and she also played for the church. When I was around between 2 and 3 she said I was always getting into things as a child, was a nervous baby.
